title: Latency and timeouts on api-gateway

detection.alert: api-gateway: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-03-24 11:49-14:49: api-gateway: 199 of 276 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-03-24 11:49 and 2026-03-24 14:49 UTC (peak error ratio 0.92 vs baseline median 0.0). 1 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 28.085 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} shrinks its outbound timeout by a factor of 1000, so calls time out almost immediately.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) converts http.timeout_ms with the wrong unit.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; fix the unit conversion at {file}:{line}; add a unit test for the timeout conversion.

rca.macro: Deploy v4.7.0 of billing-svc shrinks its outbound timeout by a factor of 1000, so calls time out almost immediately.
rca.micro: billing/client/NotificationClient.java:270 (NotificationClient.send) converts http.timeout_ms with the wrong unit.
rca.remediation: Roll back billing-svc v4.7.0 -> v4.6.0; fix the unit conversion at billing/client/NotificationClient.java:270; add a unit test for the timeout conversion.

action_items: Add a regression test covering NotificationClient.send (billing/client/NotificationClient.java).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=billing-svc`.
